TIER_1.name: Authoritative Open Data (Explicit Open License)
TIER_1.criteria: Freely accessible bulk structured datasets with explicit open data licensing (ODbL, CC-BY, Open Data Commons), verified schema stability, and no anti-scraping/API restrictions.

TIER_2.name: Official Governing Body / Franchise Public Web Feeds
TIER_2.criteria: Official competition portals (BCCI, IPLT20, Rajasthan Royals) providing public scorecards. Requires respectful rate limiting, cache TTL enforcement, and adherence to public terms of use.

TIER_3.name: Curated Structured Datasets & Manual Import
TIER_3.criteria: Internal franchise scouting records, verified manual match scorecards, and vetted domestic match logs with SHA-256 cryptographic provenance tracking.

TIER_4.name: Restricted Commercial Platforms (ToS Prohibited / Gated)
TIER_4.criteria: Commercial cricket platforms (ESPNcricinfo, Cricbuzz) with strict anti-scraping Terms of Service, anti-bot mechanisms, or commercial API paywalls. Direct scraping is strictly prohibited.

sources.name: Cricsheet

coverage.ipl_coverage: Complete ball-by-ball for all completed IPL seasons up to IPL 2025; ongoing match additions.

sources.access_method: Public structured JSON / CSV downloadable match archives

licensing.license_name: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL)
licensing.attribution_text: Data provided by Cricsheet (cricsheet.org), licensed under ODbL.

sources.rate_limits: No strict rate limit on downloads; bulk zip download recommended to minimize server load.
sources.reliability_assessment: High (industry gold standard for open ball-by-ball cricket data)
known_gaps: Real-time live ball-by-ball streaming latency (updates typically appear hours or days post-match)
Advanced tracking telemetry (release speed, spin RPM, wagon wheel coordinates) unavailable in standard feed
